Title: Osney Bridge diversion Oxford
Description: Towpath closed 150 yards upstream of Osney Bridge. Diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road. Repairs to riverbank.

Title: Marsh Lock footbridge closure Henley
Description: Unsafe footbridge closed by Environment Agency. 3-mile diversion via A4155 and Harpsden. Closure order until 31 Jan 2026, may be extended.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure
Description: Unsafe footbridge north of Sandford Lock closed. Diversion via NCN 5 cycle route.

Title: Abingdon Weir intermittent closure
Description: Walkway closed intermittently due to corrosion concerns and high river flows. Closed late Sept 2025. Reopened 30 Sept with trigger-based closures.

Title: Temple Footbridge closure Hurley
Description: Structural safety concerns. Closed 15 May 2023. Central span removed Nov 2025. Remains closed indefinitely. Diversion via Bisham and Marlow.

Title: Bridge 142 closure Runnymede Egham
Description: Structural damage to footbridge. Closed Feb 2024. Diversion via A308 and roundabout. Expected to last until at least 2026/2027.

Title: Bell Weir Lock diversion Runnymede
Description: Small diversion at Runnymede Pleasure Ground. Temporary towpath diversion for £22m weir refurbishment works.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath diversion
Description: Half-mile diversion due to eroding towpath. Riverside route unlikely to reopen until late 2026. Insufficient funding for repairs.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Island closed to public due to diseased and dangerous trees. Thames Path unaffected. No access to island until tree management completed.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure Faringdon
Description: Closed March 2024 due to structural and safety concerns. Specialist survey completed. Status unclear for reopening.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Left bank path blocked between River Brent and Brentford Marina. Redevelopment ongoing. Alternative: Brentford High Street or use right bank/Thames Lock route.
